source_boundaries.initial.xml: Initial uncommitted evaluator arithmetic checks before interval recovery, complete registration identity checks and checked-archive integration were added. Its exact source revision was not committed; it is retained as historical development output only.
source_boundaries.focused.xml: Recovery evaluator, checked archive and fitting interface tests on source_commit. Synthetic parameters and cache-format receipts are software fixtures, not accepted MCMC evidence.

checks: Existing synthetic observations, catalogue and deterministic truth remain unchanged when latent parameters are captured
Exact binary posterior has uniform randomized parameter and likelihood ranks
Prior-only inference in that exact example passes parameter ranks but fails likelihood-rank uniformity
Same-draw state intervals agree with the existing pairwise recovery convention
One value-independent selected draw per chain, with reproducible truth-inclusive tie randomization
Complete fixed study inventory distinguishes stress cases and refuses aggregate tests on a successful subset
Source-matched immutable archive identity and registration are required by the checked consumer
Direct arithmetic evaluations cannot verify fits or authorize publication

full_suite.reason: This change adds a development evaluator without changing the hashed model, generator, data or publication path. Related tests passed; the last full suite still has the documented stale qualifying-export failures.

limitations: No full recovery-calibration study registration, replicate counts or power justification exists yet.
The coarse rank policy still requires independently initialized, adequately sampled chains and a prospective sensitivity justification.
Conditional generator checks do not establish end-to-end weekend or real-world adequacy.
Expected-point and ranking-functional recovery remain unimplemented.
The original failed numerical case remains failed, and the separate proposed study still needs approval.
Predictive comparisons, prospective evidence, artifact regeneration and production checks remain incomplete.
